svg.title: 01 Campus, my core project: a site and an app for one study group that lives on the group leader's own computer. 189 Java classes, 163 Svelte components, 103 test files, 35 DB migrations, 30 versions, v1.0.1 latest release.
svg.desc: How it works: the host computer runs the server with SQLite and encrypted files; a free HTTPS tunnel gives the group a link; every phone and laptop keeps its own copy and works offline. Sync packets run from the host to each device.

g.text: A site and an app for one study group: homework,

on the group leader's own computer, and every
